label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: Bundled page copy says 'Click here to rectify all strange wallet issues' and 'Click here to claim airdrop or resolve errors encountered during airdrop claim'. These lures target wallet and airdrop users.

The bundle includes user-facing wallet solution options 'Missing/Irregular Balance', 'Asset Recovery', 'Trust Wallet', 'WalletConnect', 'Coinbase Wallet', and a field named 'seedPhrase' — a visible, specific request for wallet recovery secrets.
The page claims to be a 'trusted DeFi solution' for resolving wallet issues, token claims, staking and more, which is the standard pretext used to trick visitors into disclosing wallet credentials.

label: fam-payment-verify.vercel.app
title: FamPay Payment Gateway
reasons: Page presents itself as a 'FamPay Gateway' with 'Secure & Fast UPI Payments' and a 'Pay Now' checkout form, impersonating the real Indian fintech FamPay to collect visitors' data.

Form fields amount, customer_name, customer_email, and customer_phone POST to /create-payment, asking visitors to submit a payment amount and personal details under the false pretense of paying FamPay, with no indication this is operated by FamPay (repo: github.com/exploits99621/payment-verify).
Standalone checkout page has no real gateway, seller, or disclaimer; anyone submitting would disclose their name, email, phone, and intended payment amount to the page operator.

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: The page's CONNECT, all 'Select Required AI Function' links and 'Get Started' button redirect to /connect/index.html, with functions including 'Validation', 'Assets Recovery', 'Claim Airdrop' and 'Restore your Account'.

Copy claims the protocol 'will define a test transaction... does not have real effects on accounts connected' and promises '100% Gas Refunds' - a false reassurance used to get visitors to approve wallet transactions.

The page embeds wallet-connect components (iframe to verify.walletconnect.com/9a504add1206ecb902aee52264862b81 and a cbwsdk walletlink session) to initiate a wallet connection under the fake 'EVM Resolve' protocol.

label: gmail-account.vercel.app

label: ddpay-support-help-line-support-sec-lime.vercel.app
title: DDPay
reasons: Complete page source hardcodes a Telegram bot token and chat ID and posts to `https://api.telegram.org/bot${BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage` via `sendTelegram()`.

`handleSignIn()` reads `login-pass` and `login-pin` and sends `✅ Sign In attempt
📱 Phone: ...
🔑 Password: ...

The register screen sends `🆕 New registration` with username, phone and password to the same Telegram bot, and the OTP modal instructs users to enter a 6-digit code that is also forwarded to Telegram.
